newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SMB re-rides IPO fever, tops actives.
newsitem.headline: SMB re-rides IPO fever, tops actives.

text.p: Switchgear maker SMB United took the top actives spot in morning trade on Wednesday as retail investors piled into the counter, spurred by the IPO fever in Singapore, dealers said.
At 0231 GMT, SMB rose Singapore $0.03 to S$0.355 on top volume of 18 million shares.
"It's the IPO fever. Investors are relooking at recently listed stocks. And SMB, at 30-over cents, is the kind of stock they like," said a trader.
Dealers said interior design and furniture comanpy's Nobel Design Holdings' strong performance since its listing on Monday, has rekindled interest in low-priced newly-listed counters.

Nobel rose for the third consecutive day, up S$0.03 to S$0.665 after hitting a high of S$0.68 on Wednesday morning. It was the second top active with 16.9 million shares. Its IPO price was just S$0.33 each.
